description: This file defines an Android Activity class 'PackageShortcutActivity' which provides a UI for managing package shortcuts, including methods to generate intents for launching and binding the activity, and setting up its UI with fragments based on intent extras.

classes.name: PackageShortcutActivity
classes.description: An Android Activity that constructs a shortcut launcher UI, manages shortcut-related intent creation, and displays a fragment with shortcut options.

methods.name: getLaunchIntent
methods.description: Constructs an intent to launch the PackageShortcutActivity with specified target package, activity, user, and title.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets the layout, retrieves intent extras, creates a fragment with those extras, sets the activity's title, and commits the fragment transaction.
